verdict.rationale: The docs show recurring scheduling through natural-language instructions: the getting-started example asks the dot to check a channel 'each weekday at 9 AM Central for the next four weeks' (dots-docs-14). The controls page confirms 'future scheduled runs' exist apart from the main task (dots-docs-22), and the cloud-hosted dot keeps working while your computer is off (dots-docs-2). missing for 10: dedicated documentation on creating, listing, editing or cancelling schedules, details on trigger types and recurrence limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration that scheduled runs fire reliably.
